unavailable_or_unclassified: Fixed b and Gamma, actual code preservation and exact controlled phases are binding. The concrete noncommuting GL(2,F2) model acts uniformly on paired logical coordinates, not individually selected addresses. Complete local hardware/control and separately resolved reset channels are required. The finite-group word can be classically compressed to one final target by an equally informed ordinary controller, so absence of a separate command-count error term is not computational speedup. No autonomous instruction distribution, scalable changing partners, universal/non-Clifford computation, repeated decode/reinsert, arbitrary quantum handoff or practical threshold follows. Later retirement/destructive-output theorems are separate terminal extensions. The companion cyclic-clock failure is source-reported at its own narrow scope.
